sections.description: The sync plugin connects StageKitWP to Microsoft Graph and imports SharePoint content into the plugin’s custom post types and media library.
sections.installation: Upload the stagekitwp-sync plugin folder to wp-content/plugins/, activate it, and connect the required credentials from the Sync admin screen.
sections.changelog: Release notes are maintained in the plugin repository.

name: stagekitwp-sync
author: StageKitWP
short_description: Sync SharePoint content and image data into the StageKitWP content model using Microsoft Graph.
